decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the firm's established office offer into a growing workplace segment, has its own page, and likely meets aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

A chair family close to the core business uses existing craftsmanship and sales channels, and its prominent presentation suggests satisfactory results that the firm's slack (it is hiring) easily supports.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory whose results are uncertain, but they are low-cost to carry and fit the firm's interiors offer, so with available slack the firm likely keeps them for now.

The soft upholstered sofa is close to the core business, but it is only mentioned on the website, which hints at weaker emphasis; it is still likely kept because it fits the living segment at low incremental cost.
The high standing table fits the flexible office and conference trend and the firm's existing competencies, with its own page indicating results at or above aspiration.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's established offer and its fit is more uncertain, raising the risk of a shortfall against aspirations, but slack and the move toward curated full interiors make keeping it somewhat more likely than dropping it.
